items: "Try it" opens an app you have, like YouTube Shorts, not only TikTok.
Step-by-step pictures for turning SlopSwipe on, and a "Couldn't find the switch?" card on Home.
First tap on the AI button asks: skip this video, or also block the account.
Steadier skipping: scrolling comments no longer counts as a new video, and no more false undo errors.
New Rule set page in Settings: see the rules in use and which app versions they support, check for updates, turn automatic updates on or off, import from file, or restore the built-in version.
Instagram Reels: rules updated for the latest Instagram. SlopSwipe acts in the Reels tab, and Reels is now on by default for new installs.
